features: MICRO-USB - With Micro-USB port USB C100 Action Camera utilizes a USB port charger method connector which brings great convenience for users
MAGNETIC BODY - Worry no more about losing your camera, mount it on yourself! With any angle rotation and magnetic body, it ensures convenient hands-free recording

1080P 30FPS ACTION CAMERA - With Normal mode & Time-lapse video & Car mode 1080P 30FPS video recording; it is perfect for short-video apps. The 15 megapixels image sensor ensures that you get a crisp and clear video
LIVE MODE & WIFI 2.4 GHZ - Change formats anytime you want, be it landscape or portrait mode. Wirelessly connect to your app for hassle-free sharing
PACKAGE INCLUDES - 1 x Camera, 1 x Waterproof Case, 1 x Back Clip, 1 x Frame Mount, 1 x Base Mount, 1 x Screw, 1 x Lanyard, 1 x Curved and Flat Mount, 1 x USB Cable, 1 x 2x3m Adhesive Sticker
description: SJCAM C100 Action Camera captures short video clips of 1, 3, 5, 10, and 15 minutes in up to Full HD 1080p30 resolution with audio. Your videos and up to 15MP high-resolution photos are all stored on a microSD card, sold separately. Via built-in Wi-Fi, you can connect to the included iOS/Android SJCAM app, where you can download your recorded videos and photos and share them directly to social media platforms. The companion app also offers some editing tools and allows you to live stream from the camera and use the camera for video chats.
